title: Surreal Cognitive Recursion
subtitle: Monochrome optical thought loop and impossible Escher staircase
description: Inspired by A. L. Crego (@ALCrego_). A stark monochrome optical surrealism study featuring recursive contemplation silhouettes, an impossible perpetual Escher staircase, rotating thought cogs with optical moiré line hatching, and cascading philosophical spheres in eternal harmonic motion.
